tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background for every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, table bodies on ground. ranger green.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered or selected rows, open menus, the active tab.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Status bars, footers, the nav strip; the darkest band on a screen.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, panel borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; 3:1+ on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, surface-raised and deep.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, DTGs on ground, surface, surface-raised and deep.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: coyote. Primary buttons, active nav, the display name, key numbers. As text on any ground.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: copper (from the logo's star, lifted for contrast). The one thing that needs attention: next op, objective, unread. One per panel.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: GO, confirmed, RSVP yes. Always with the word.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: PENDING, awaiting RSVP. Always with the word.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: NO-GO, abort, overdue. Always with the word; shown as a filled chip so it never reads as accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, every interactive element.

tokens.name: mark-navy
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact from the source file. Print and merch only, not UI.

tokens.name: mark-red
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact. Print and merch only.

tokens.name: mark-gold
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact. Print and merch only.

tokens.name: mark-copper
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact (the star). The UI accent in Field is its lifted cousin.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: Logo colour, exact (the ZULU letters).

styles.name: field-hero
styles.usage: Splash and section heroes, once per screen.

styles.name: field-heading
styles.usage: Panel and OPORD paragraph heads, uppercase.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Field labels, nav, status bar, uppercase.

styles.name: field-body
styles.sample: Stage at the east gate by 0630. Comms check on channel 4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, control padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gutters between panels, screen side margins.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on splash.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default everywhere: panels, buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Status chips and tier badges.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, the logo disc, avatars.
